decks.notes: This deck aims to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It also utilizes various cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to tutor for combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Pyroblast. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Imperial Recruiter allows for flexibility in finding key pieces while maintaining control over the game. The deck's focus on quickly assembling the combo and disrupting the opponent's plans makes it a potent threat in the Legacy format.

The key concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper and Orcish Bowmasters, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Grief and Opposition Agent. The deck focuses on utilizing powerful white creatures like Archon of Emeria and Solitude to control the board and maintain tempo. The inclusion of cards like Chalice of the Void and Chrome Mox allows for explosive starts and fast mana acceleration, while also providing protection from opposing spells. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth casting of spells and maximum efficiency.

The focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Delver of Secrets. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Force of Will, Daze, and Spell Pierce while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning for additional reach. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, with cards like Mishra's Bauble and cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder helping to smooth out draws and maintain momentum.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo, utilizing cards like Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and Shuko to mill the library, play Thassa's Oracle to win the game when the library is empty. The deck also includes interaction and protection with cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler. Urza's Saga provides additional synergy with the deck's strategy. The deck aims to quickly combo off and win the game before the opponent can effectively stop it.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands, while controlling the game with cards like Pithing Needle and Crop Rotation. It utilizes powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Emrakul to win the game quickly or disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes tools for graveyard hate and protection, such as Bojuka Bog and Endurance. With access to a variety of lands and utility creatures, this archetype can adapt to different matchups and strategies, making it a versatile and powerful control deck in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's land base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void while putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss. With mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and finish the game swiftly. The deck also utilizes cards like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing for removal and reach, making it a formidable aggro deck in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by deploying powerful creatures and using disruptive spells. By combining aggressive threats like Archon of Emeria and Elite Spellbinder with mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure. Additionally, cards like Chalice of the Void and Touch the Spirit Realm provide additional disruption and protection. The deck's efficient mana base enables it to consistently deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to leverage efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler backed up by disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to control the tempo of the game. By applying pressure early with aggressive creatures and efficient removal like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats on the board. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and card advantage, while utilizing Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This Legacy aggro deck focuses on utilizing Death's Shadow as a powerful threat that benefits from lowering your own life total. Cards like Grief and Thoughtseize disrupt your opponent's hand, while Reanimate allows you to bring back key creatures. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Daze and Force of Will, as well as removal spells like Snuff Out. The mana base includes a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure you have the right colors of mana to support your spells.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out Death's Shadow and other aggressive creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. It also utilizes reanimation spells to bring back key creatures and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck is able to apply early pressure while controlling the game with counter spells and removal, making it a versatile and powerful Aggro deck in the Legacy format.

This Legacy Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence with powerful creature threats like Archon of Emeria and Seasoned Dungeoneer. The deck utilizes acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal to play threats ahead of curve, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to maintain control of the game through aggressive plays and resource denial, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and spells. With a strong mana base and a mix of disruption and card advantage, this deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and come out on top.

This Aggro-Maverick deck focuses on utilizing powerful land-based synergies to quickly ramp up and disrupt opponents. With cards like Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck can search for key lands and creatures, while cards like Endurance offer protection against graveyard strategies. The deck also includes removal like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats. By efficiently utilizing its lands and creatures, this deck aims to apply pressure early and control the game through its unique synergy and versatility.

The primary focus of this deck is to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. This combo is supported by utilizing artifacts and card draw to maintain consistency and tempo. The deck also features counter spells and utility cards to protect the combo pieces and control the board. Additionally, Urza's Saga is used to tutor for crucial artifacts like Mox Opal or additional combo pieces. Overall, the deck seeks to efficiently and swiftly execute its win condition while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library until they have no cards left, winning the game instantly. This combo can be set up using cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder, while also controlling the board with cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast. The deck also includes Karn, the Great Creator to tutor for important artifacts and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the key concept is to assemble the combo pieces efficiently and protect them while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game and out-value the opponent through card advantage and resource management. By utilizing powerful control spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, along with planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and set up winning conditions with cards like Shark Typhoon and Supreme Verdict. The inclusion of cards like Snapcaster Mage and Prismatic Ending offer flexibility and versatility in dealing with a variety of threats, making it a well-rounded and adaptable control deck.

The key concept of this UWx Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck runs a variety of counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, along with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending help deal with threats, while card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder ensure the pilot has access to their answers. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through careful decision-making and efficient resource management.
